writer_rules: Import only SHA-pinned independent Python writers; no Rust/product tools/output. Never execute their main or modify prior files.

The only change from the v2 writer: the transition serializer module is serializer3.load() (SHA-pinned; it checks its own version2 parent pin) - Profile3 ID1 envelope, Job3 free cells, Root3 cells with row_high@432 = 0 and the Job3 census aggregate. All other phase code is the unchanged version2 serializer.
serializer3.row_job is not used: every history is Catalog scope2 only. Row cells placed without Row groups are not replayable and must not enter these corpora.
Actor callback maps native model cycle2 to epoch2/local1; sequence/object/slot/Job generations remain model cycle2. Creator/source actors retained across later epochs.
Build every semantic native/sender/descriptor/projection/page hash from the declared before state. Only outer XWF epoch and its two seals change per process; predecessor logical LSN remains absolute.
System scope1 frames use the independent Free Undo operation serializer with the Profile3 envelope and explicit L2..5 schedule; allocator/page outputs must equal serializer3 setup outputs.

Store immutable full changed pages, whole Jobs, Tx/Aging descriptor, semantic/System frame, and exact allocated-page state at L8/9/10/15/16/19/25. Free/Reserved page logical arena is zero; stale freed home bytes are not claimed zero.

No base image is written. The selected base (XRB1 base4 header/provenance/certificate/inventory) is product output after U2-C2 and the switch, audited by the native controller against these expected images; these literals do not issue selected-source authority.
auditor_rules: Separate stdlib raw parser; do not import generator or reused writer helper.

Verify raw full inventory/hashes, exact rows/LSNs/epochs/offsets/lengths, envelope checksum, actor ownership, Root conservation/credit, native/header/redo identity and fixed checkpoints from this plan. Root3/Job3 version3 cells, row_high 0 with bytes 440..512 zero, no Job kind3, Profile3 profile blob.
Compare the v2 native corpus only for schedule equivalence (row IDs, LSN, epoch, kind, operation, frame length, WAL offsets, page-role sets, checkpoint scalars); Profile-bound bytes differ by design.
Native controller must independently validate actual selected base/old-WAL removal+dirsync/ACK ledger; generator result is never runtime PASS.
